faculty.name: Ignacio Acevedo
faculty.summary: Studies adolescent sociopolitical development, focusing on promoting community engagement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年政治社会发展，侧重于促进社区参与。

faculty.name: Adrienne Adams
faculty.summary: Studies community and ecological factors influencing mental health and well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社区和生态因素对心理健康和福祉的影响。

faculty.name: Melissa Allman
faculty.summary: Studies mediated conditioning in rodents, focusing on learning about stimuli and generalization effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的中介性条件作用，关注刺激学习和泛化效应。

faculty.name: Erik Altmann
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算模型和实验研究认知过程。

faculty.name: Kaston D. Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of socioeconomic status, built environment, and community connectedness on behavioral health outcomes, using theoretically-grounded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位、建成环境和社区联系对行为健康结果的影响，采用理论导向的研究方法。

faculty.name: Aldo M. Barrita
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological impact of microaggressions on minoritized communities and develops quantitative measures for oppression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日常压迫对少数群体的心理影响，并开发衡量压迫的量化指标。

faculty.name: Mark Becker
faculty.summary: Studies attention and perception, using behavioral experiments and psychophysical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意和知觉，使用行为实验和心理物理学方法。

faculty.name: Marisa Beeble
faculty.summary: Studies the criminal justice system's response to female offenders, aiming to improve their treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究刑事司法系统对女性犯罪者的应对措施，旨在改善其待遇。

faculty.name: Tara S. Behrend
faculty.summary: Studies the ethical, social, and psychological implications of workplace technologies, including electronic surveillance and human-AI interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作场所技术的伦理、社会和心理影响，包括电子监控和人机交互。

faculty.name: Jan Brascamp
faculty.summary: Studies how sensation becomes conscious perception using psychophysics, fMRI, and brain stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉如何转化为意识知觉，使用心理物理学、功能性磁共振成像和脑刺激技术。

faculty.name: Susan Barman
faculty.summary: Studies the role of neurons in the lateral tegmental field in autonomic reflexes and respiratory control, using electrophysiology and computer-aided analyses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中脑网状场内侧区神经元在自主反射和呼吸控制中的作用，使用电生理学和计算机辅助分析方法。

faculty.name: S Marc Breedlove
faculty.summary: Studies the effect of steroid hormones on the developing and adult nervous system, including sexual differentiation and plasticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究类固醇激素对发育和成年神经系统的影响，包括性分化和可塑性。

faculty.name: Daniel Campbell
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of autism-related long noncoding RNAs and environmental factors on brain development, using human neurons.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症相关长非编码RNA和环境因素对大脑发育的影响，使用人类神经元细胞.

faculty.name: Alex Castillo-Ruiz
faculty.summary: Studies how birth and microbiota affect brain and behavioral development in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究出生和微生物如何影响小鼠的大脑和行为发育。

faculty.name: Charles L. Cox
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular mechanisms of behavioral plasticity, focusing on thalamocortical circuits and their role in sensory processing and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为可塑性的细胞机制，集中在丘脑-皮层回路及其在感觉处理和注意力中的作用。

faculty.name: Shane Crandall
faculty.summary: Studies how brain circuits control sensations, focusing on neocortex and thalamus using electrophysiology and optical tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑回路如何控制感觉，重点研究新皮层和丘脑，使用电生理学和光学工具。

faculty.name: Anne Dorrance
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using pharmacological and genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用药理学和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Heather L Eisthen
faculty.summary: Studies evolutionary changes in nervous systems and their behavioral consequences, focusing on chemical signals, toxins, and infrared sensing in amphibians and snakes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统进化的因果关系及其行为后果，重点关注两栖动物和蛇类中的化学信号、毒素和红外感知。

faculty.name: Kimberly Fenn
faculty.summary: Studies the role of sleep in learning complex skills and episodic memory, using fMRI to examine biological mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠在学习复杂技能和情景记忆中的作用，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）探讨生物机制。

faculty.name: Yuen Gao
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Assaf Gilad
faculty.summary: Develops genetically encoded gene circuits and fusion proteins for understanding the central nervous system, replacing electronic devices.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发基因电路和融合蛋白以理解中枢神经系统，替代电子设备。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Heath-Heckman
faculty.summary: Studies host-microbe interactions and neurodevelopment in invertebrates using genomic techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究宿主-微生物互作和无脊椎动物的神经发育，使用基因组技术。

faculty.name: Casey L Henley
faculty.summary: Studies neurobiology and cell and molecular medicine in neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经生物学和细胞与分子医学的神经科学。

faculty.name: Hanne Hoffmann
faculty.summary: Studies how biological timing and light exposure affect reproduction, pregnancy, and labor in various mammals, integrating neuroendocrinology and physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物节律和光照如何影响哺乳动物的繁殖、妊娠和分娩，结合神经内分泌学和生理学方法。

faculty.name: Jie Huang
faculty.summary: Develops novel fMRI methods and investigates the neurological bases of visual stress in migraine patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发新的功能性磁共振成像方法并研究视觉诱发偏头痛的神经基础。

faculty.name: Alex Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms of learning and motivation using behavioral procedures and neuroscience techniques in both animals and humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和动机的神经机制，使用行为程序和神经科学技术在动物和人类中。

faculty.name: Florian Kagerer
faculty.summary: Studies motor learning and adaptation using behavioral and electrophysiological techniques to investigate upper limb coordination and brain dynamics during movement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动学习和适应，使用行为技术和电生理技术（如运动捕捉、脑电图和经颅磁刺激）来探究上肢协调和运动期间的大脑动态。

faculty.name: Rebecca Knickmeyer
faculty.summary: Studies how the gut microbiota, genetics, and sex differences influence infant brain development, using neuroimaging and genomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究微生物群、遗传学和性别差异如何影响婴儿大脑发育，使用神经影像学和基因组学方法。

faculty.name: Geoffroy Olivier Laumet
faculty.summary: Studies the communication between neurons and immune cells in chronic pain, using mouse models and genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元与免疫细胞之间的通讯在慢性疼痛中的作用，使用小鼠模型和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Gina Leinninger
faculty.summary: Studies the neurophysiological mechanisms by which neurons in the lateral hypothalamic area regulate energy balance and contribute to obesity and metabolic disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究下丘脑外侧区神经元的神经生理机制，这些机制调控能量平衡并导致肥胖和代谢疾病。

faculty.name: Jinxing Li
faculty.summary: Develops nanoscale devices to stimulate and sense signals from individual neurons, enabling precise examination and manipulation of neural circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发纳米尺度设备以刺激和感知单个神经元信号，精确地研究和操控神经回路。

faculty.name: Weiming Li
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of vertebrate physiology and gene families using sea lampreys as a model.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脊椎动物生理机制和基因家族的进化，使用海无颌鱼作为模型。

faculty.name: Taosheng Liu
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention, visual working memory, and perceptual decision making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力、视觉工作记忆和知觉决策。

faculty.name: Joseph Lonstein
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of peripartum emotional regulation and maternal behaviors in rodents, focusing on the BST and its role in anxiety and mothering trade-offs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳期情绪调节和母性行为的神经生物学，重点关注下外侧隔核及其在焦虑和母性行为权衡中的作用。

faculty.name: Andrew Mason
faculty.summary: Studies microsystem sensor technologies for enhancing human awareness, wellness, social perception, and cognitive performance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究微系统传感器技术以增强人类意识、福祉、社会感知和认知表现。

faculty.name: Michelle Mazei-Robison
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of changes in VTA dopamine neuron signaling and morphology induced by stress and drugs, using behavioral assays and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激和药物诱导的中脑导水管周围灰质多巴胺神经元信号传导和形态变化的分子机制，使用行为学和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: J. Devin McAuley
faculty.summary: Studies auditory perception, attention and memory, and the relationship between music and language using computational modeling and dynamic systems approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉感知、注意力和记忆以及音乐与语言之间的关系，使用计算建模和动态系统方法。

faculty.name: Dar Meshi
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain processes socially communicated information, using neuroimaging and experimental methods to understand motivations and decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理社会传达的信息，使用神经成像和实验方法来理解动机和决策过程。

faculty.name: Adam Moeser
faculty.summary: Studies the pathophysiologic mechanisms of stress-induced gastrointestinal and immune disorders, focusing on early life adversity, neuro-immune signaling, and biological sex differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激诱导的消化道和免疫障碍的病理生理机制，重点关注早期生活应激、神经免疫信号传导和生物性别差异。

faculty.name: Jason Moser
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive, emotional, and behavioral regulation, and their clinical significance in anxiety and depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、情绪和行为调节的神经机制及其在焦虑和抑郁中的临床意义。

faculty.name: Lucas Pozzo-Miller
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons communicate and the role of calcium signaling in learning and memory, using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元如何交流以及钙信号在学习和记忆中的作用，使用电生理学和成像技术。

faculty.name: Chunqi Qian
faculty.summary: Develops wirelessly powered multi-modal detectors to correlate fMRI signals with EEG and fiber photometry, improving understanding of NGV interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发无线供电多模态检测器，将fMRI信号与EEG和光纤光度计相关联，以改善对NGV相互作用的理解。

faculty.name: Tian Qiu
faculty.summary: Studies chemical processes in the brain, using analytical chemistry techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中的化学过程，使用分析化学技术。

faculty.name: Susan Ravizza
faculty.summary: Studies working memory and task switching using fMRI, neuropsychological, and behavioral techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和任务切换，使用功能性磁共振成像、神经心理学和行为技术。

faculty.name: Alfred J Robison
faculty.summary: Studies how drug addiction and chronic stress alter gene expression in the hippocampus, using transgenic mice and viral gene-transfer tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和慢性应激如何通过转基因小鼠和病毒基因转移工具改变海马的基因表达。

faculty.name: Debajit Saha
faculty.summary: Studies neural engineering and brain-computer interfaces to understand associative learning and decision-making in insects, developing insect-based chemical sensors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经工程和脑-机接口技术，理解昆虫的关联学习和决策机制，并开发基于昆虫的化学传感器。

faculty.name: Fathi Salem
faculty.summary: Develops methodologies and computational algorithms for predicting critical transitions in engineered and biological systems using neural network models and statistical entropy.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发用于预测工程和生物系统中临界转变的方法论和计算算法，使用神经网络模型和统计熵。

faculty.name: Ralf Schmälzle
faculty.summary: Studies neural responses to dynamic real-world messages, comparing brain activity similarities across different recipients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动态现实信息的神经反应，比较不同接收者的大脑活动相似性。

faculty.name: Caryl Sortwell
faculty.summary: Studies how the growth factor pleiotrophin affects the development and maintenance of the nigrostriatal system in a rat model of Parkinson's disease, and whether deep brain stimulation can slow.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生长因子pleiotrophin (PTN) 对黑质纹状体系统的影响及其在帕金森病动物模型中的神经修复作用，以及深部脑刺激是否可以减缓疾病进展。

faculty.name: Greg M Swain
faculty.summary: Studies neuromuscular signaling in the gastrointestinal tract using electrochemical methods and pharmacological tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用电化学方法和药理学工具研究消化道的神经肌肉信号传导。

faculty.name: Katy Thakkar
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and biological mechanisms of psychotic disorders, particularly schizophrenia, using MRI, eye tracking, and experimental psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症等精神病性障碍的认知和生物机制，使用MRI、眼动追踪和实验心理学方法。

faculty.name: Barbara Thompson
faculty.summary: Studies affective processing and reward circuitry disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders, using both basic science and clinical research methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍中情感处理和奖励电路中断的神经生物学基础，采用基础科学和临床研究方法。

faculty.name: Nathan Tykocki
faculty.summary: Studies how the urinary bladder wall's mechanical properties affect the sensation of fullness and how social stress impacts bladder function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究尿道壁的机械特性如何影响膀胱充盈感以及社会压力如何导致膀胱功能障碍。

faculty.name: Alexa Veene
faculty.summary: Studies the roles of vasopressin and oxytocin in social behavior using rats and various techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究血管加压素和催产素在社会行为中的作用，使用大鼠和多种技术方法。

faculty.name: Michael Williams
faculty.summary: Studies the role of Autism Spectrum Disorder candidate genes in neuronal development, using viral and transgenic animal strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍候选基因在神经发育中的作用，使用病毒和转基因动物策略。

faculty.name: Lily Yan
faculty.summary: Studies how light affects mood and cognition, using rodent models and cognitive tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究光照如何影响情绪和认知，使用啮齿动物模型和认知任务来阐明其神经机制。

faculty.name: Mengsen Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies complex systems in neuroscience using computational methods and dynamical systems theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学中的复杂系统，使用计算方法和动力系统理论。

faculty.name: Qingguang Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of cerebrovascular physiology and its impact on brain function using advanced imaging and cellular techniques in mouse models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑血管生理机制及其对脑功能的影响，使用高级成像技术和细胞技术在小鼠模型中探究。
